abstract: PURPOSE: We report our experience with simultaneous resection of residual masses above and below the diaphragm in patients with metastatic nomseminomatous germ cell tumor (NSGCT) of the testis. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Twenty-four patients underwent simultaneous resection of residual postchemotherapy masses in the retroperitoneum and chest, including three who also had radical neck dissection. All had been heavily pretreated with chemotherapy and five had undergone previous retroperitoneal lymph node dissections (RPLNDs). RESULTS: The combined procedure was performed with no mortality and low morbidity. The median length of the procedure was 5 hours 45 minutes, median blood loss 500 mL, and median length of hospital stay 9 days. Complications included one patient with chylous ascites and one with a prolonged air leak, both of which resolved with conservative management. Eighteen patients had similar pathologic findings in all sites: 13 with necrosis only and five with teratoma only. Six patients had discordant pathology in the abdomen and chest, including one with viable tumor in the chest only and two with viable tumor in the abdomen only. The overall actuarial 5-year survival rate for all patients was 79%. CONCLUSION: Simultaneous resection of neck, chest, and abdominal residual masses after chemotherapy for germ cell tumors is both a feasible and safe alternative to staged excision in selected patients who require surgical intervention at multiple sites and fulfills the objective of rendering patients disease-free in a single operative procedure.
abstract_ja: 目的:転移性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者において、横隔膜の上下の残存腫瘤を同時に切除した経験を報告する。方法:化学療法後の後腹膜および胸部の残存腫瘤を同時に切除された患者24例を対象とした。このうち3例は根治的頸部郭清も併施された。全例が強力な前治療を受けており、5例は以前に後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を受けていた。結果:併用手術は死亡例なく、合併症も少なかった。手術時間中央値は5時間45分、出血量中央値は500mL、入院期間中央値は9日であった。合併症は乳糜腹水が1例、長期の気漏が1例で、いずれも保存的治療で改善した。18例は全部位で類似の病理所見を示し、13例は壊死のみ、5例は奇形腫のみであった。6例は腹部と胸部で病理所見が一致せず、そのうち1例は胸部のみに生存腫瘍、2例は腹部のみに生存腫瘍があった。全患者の5年全生存率(actuarial)は79%であった。結論:化学療法後の胚細胞腫瘍における頸部、胸部、腹部の残存腫瘤の同時切除は、多部位で外科的切除を要する選択された患者において、段階的切除に代わる実行可能かつ安全な方法であり、単回の手術で患者を無病状態にするという目標を満たす。
